authority: Owner decision for R3.5 stage 5 recovery screening, revision 4
reason: dev-20261020-v5 failed only the four sufficient-guidance gates. Diagnosis found the four deliveryUnknown regressions (f07, f09, s02, s05) return the correct runbook sections, so the defects are demand-model and label-artefact defects, not retrieval defects. f07 and s02 need investigation+remediation and s05 needs remediation+forbidden; f07 and s02 share identical signal sets, so no single deliveryUnknown demand can satisfy both under the 3-slot cap. Revision 4 records the one predeclared composite implementation (D1a + D1b + D2-accept) before any revision-4 score exists.
changes: D1b: added typed dedupWindowExpired signal requiring both deduplication_window_expired and same_request_key_known, first in fixed signal order, demand remediation/forbidden/verification

D2-accept: f04-sibling-destination-repair verification accepts RB-F03-F04@1.0.0#verification-rollback-or-escalation as its second citation; RB-F04-F06@1.0.0#verification-rollback-or-escalation remains first and strict canonical
development labels v2 -> v3 with exactly one changed row and 31 unchanged rows
development.combined.labelsFile and labelsConstituentsFile point at the v3 artifacts

decisions.D1a: deliveryUnknown now requests investigation, remediation, verification. f07 and s02 need remediation; forbidden is no longer demanded by this signal.
decisions.D1b: dedupWindowExpired is a typed signal derived only when fixture facts contain both deduplication_window_expired and same_request_key_known. It precedes deliveryUnknown and requests remediation, forbidden, verification. The no-match cases nm02 (concurrent_idempotent_requests) and nm08 (invalid_idempotency_key) do not fire it.
decisions.D1c: No per-facet suppression, early return, or signal special-casing was added. Fixed order plus 3-slot truncation is the whole mechanism. evidenceAnchors and the anchor regex are unchanged, so demand changes cannot move support or abstention.

declined.reason: Not independently sufficient for a credential plus template overlap

declinedEquivalences.reason: Not independently sufficient for a credential plus template overlap. RB-F04-F06#read-only-investigation covers template and registry validation, while the observed overlap requires the credential-presence and worker-environment reasoning in RB-F03-F04#read-only-investigation. Joint sufficiency would require amending labelEquivalence.requirements, so it is deferred to corpus-v2 work and is not slipped into revision 4.
